title: Batching and copy-budget spike
objective: Measure representative native, managed/unmanaged, and Web Worker copy paths and define an evidence-backed provisional copy budget.
validations: real browser Worker benchmark: PASS with clone and transferable ArrayBuffer results from 4 KiB through 16 MiB
manual result consistency review: clone cost grows with payload size; transfer remains the required large-payload path
risks: Synthetic throughput does not predict a future solver workload or every browser and device.
